title: PresenceStatus/set missing receiptSharing in update keys
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md line 1162: PresenceStatus/set update supports list reads 'presence, statusText, statusEmoji, expiresAt'. The newly added receiptSharing field (line 784) is not included. A client that calls PresenceStatus/set to change receiptSharing receives no error and no effect — or a conforming server would silently ignore the key as unsupported. The field is defined but unreachable through the API. Fix: add receiptSharing to the PresenceStatus/set update-supports list.
